name: Decline Sit Up (Bodyweight)
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with arms crossed on your chest.
Curl up and sit all the way up, bringing your chest toward your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the start.
cues: Breathe out on the way up
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A sit-up on a decline bench that trains the abs and hip flexors through a full range.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
commonMistakes: Arching the back on the way down
safetyNotes: Reduce the decline if it strains your lower back.
